definitions.standard: The process of breakdown of food in the cell with the release of energy.
definitions.simple: The way your body's tiny cells eat food and use oxygen to make energy, so you can run, play, and live!
definitions.scientific: A set of metabolic reactions and processes that take place in the cells of organisms to convert biochemical energy from nutrients into adenosine triphosphate (ATP), and then release waste products.

counter_examples: Just breathing air in and out (that's ventilation)

advanced_data.history: Discovered progressively as scientists understood that lungs just provide oxygen to the blood, which takes it to the cells.

common_misconceptions: Respiration is just breathing. (False, breathing is just taking air in/out. Respiration happens in every single cell to make energy).
tutor_context.tutor_hint: Remind them that breathing is the delivery truck, and respiration is the factory using the delivered goods.
